sources.title: Introducing Gemini Robotics and Gemini Robotics-ER, AI models designed ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are introducing two new AI models, based on Gemini 2.0, which lay the foundation for a new generation of helpful robots. The first is Gemini Robotics, an advanced vision-language-action (VLA) model that was built on Gemini 2.0 with the addition of physical actions as a new output modality for the purpose of directly controlling robots.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics: Bringing AI into the Physical World
sources.snippet: This report introduces a new family of AI models purposefully designed for robotics and built upon the foundation of Gemini 2.0. We present Gemini Robotics, an advanced Vision-Language-Action (VLA) generalist model capable of directly controlling robots.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics 1.5 brings AI agents into the physical world
sources.snippet: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5 - Our most capable vision-language model (VLM) reasons about the physical world, natively calls digital tools and creates detailed, multi-step plans to complete a mission. This model now achieves state-of-the-art performance across spatial understanding benchmarks.

sources.title: Vision-Language-Action in Robotics: A Survey of Datasets, Benchmarks ...
sources.snippet: Despite remarkable progress in Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models, a central bottleneck remains underexamined: the data infrastructure that underlies embodied learning. In this survey, we argue that future advances in VLA will depend less on model architecture and more on the co-design of high-fidelity data engines and structured evaluation protocols.
